title: The Ascendant
author: J.S. Holloway
note: conf=0.95; Amazon Kindle listing confirms "The Ascendant: A Cyberpunk Thriller (The Veil Trilogy Book 2)" by J.S. Holloway (ASIN B0GHRSGDDV). Series verified by sibling volumes: Neon Veil (Book 1) and Analogue Dreams (Book 3), the latter described as the finale of the trilogy begun with Neon Veil. "A Cyberpunk Thriller" is a marketing subtitle, so canonical title is "The Ascendant".
